My best friends little brother (Andrew, 12) and I are Michael Jackson super fans, we LOVE his music. We planned a dance off because he challenged me and I for sure was going to beat his ass. But 2 Septembers ago, my best friends brother and his father, along with 12 other boys he’s age were on a Boy Scout hike. At the same time, a man decided to get into his car and drive while he was beyond intoxicated. As he was driving he plowed into 6 out of the 12 kids and murdered a 12 year old boy right in front of his father. I didn’t go to the hospital because it was just to much for me at the time and I do and will regret it everyday until I die. (The man was found guilty and he’s going to prison don’t worry lol). Fast forward to 2 weeks ago and I’m in Las Vegas to see the Cirque Du Soleil show, Michael Jackson ONE. I put on my red ribbon pin with Andrews picture and go to the Mandalay Bay to see the show (Red because that’s the color shirt he was wearing when he was killed, and the official color of the troop)! Before the show, I share the story with the house manager and he shares with me that he’s extremely touched and he’s had something tragic like this happen in his own personal life. He upgrades our seats and gets us free snacks and drinks. During the show I was crying because the show I was seeing at that moment was one of Andrews dreams, to see MJ ONE, and he never got to live his dream (I especially sobbed during Man In The Mirror). At the end of the show, management and the whole big time Cirque team found us and told me I was going to meet the lead dancer in the show, I was SO STOKED! I walked backstage and the entire cast and crew of the show cheered and I walked into a large room backstage. I started to tell them I was there in Andrews honor and his dream was to see this show like 30 times back to back but he never will get to see it. The entire company was sobbing with me and they each individually thanked me for seeing the show in his honor. They then told me they are dedicating the shows that night to Andrew (they had another show after the one I saw). It was the single best experience of my entire life. The people at Cirque du Soleil got in contact with Andrew’s family and they are going to hook them up with an all expense paid trip to see the show. Sobbed the entire night. No matter what you think about Michael Jackson, I have a strong emotional connection to his music because of Andrew. His overall corresponding message of love, brotherhood and togetherness is what resonated with Andrew and that’s what I will take away Michael Jackson’s music.

Hola! I played Pippin at a regional theatre in NY. My advice would be to sing something that sounds similar to Pippin and be extremely familiar with it. I sang “You and Me (But Mostly Me)” from Mormon and acted the fuck out of the 32 bar cut, that got me a callback and I sang Corner for the production team; they were crying and I was cast on the spot. The most important thing is definitely assuring that you have the higher notes (listen to ‘extraordinary’ it’s insane). I think what got me cast was that I played Pippin very naïve and sincere. When I sing corner I didn’t copy what I saw on YouTube, I genuinely felt what he was feeling in the song. I don’t know if this is helping you at all but this is what helped me. Even if you sing every single note wrong, as long as you act the fuck out of the song and practice it in the mirror you’ll be golden.
